params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} Whenever {{ci|Jayce}} switches between {{sbc|{{ai|Transform Mercury Hammer|Jayce|Hammer Stance}}}} and {{sbc|{{ai|Transform Mercury Cannon|Jayce|Cannon Stance}}}}, he briefly gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} and {{tip|ghosting|ignores}} unit collision.
params.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Whenever '''Jayce''' switches between either {{sbc|{{ai|Transform Mercury Hammer|Jayce|Hammer Stance}}}} or {{sbc|{{ai|Transform Mercury Cannon|Jayce|Cannon Stance}}}}, he gains {{tip|ghosting}} and {{sti|ms|{{as|30 '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for {{fd|0.75}} seconds.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Jayce}} leaps to the target enemy's location and smashes his hammer to the ground, dealing {{as|physical damage}} and {{tip|slow|slowing}} nearby enemies.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jayce''' {{tip|dash|leaps}} to the target enemy's location over {{fd|0.5}} seconds. Upon arrival, he smashes his hammer to the ground to deal {{as|physical damage}} to all enemies within an area and {{tip|slow}} them for 2 seconds.
params.description2: ''To the Skies!'' deals {{as|10 '''bonus''' physical damage}} to {{tip|monsters}}.
params.description3: ''{{ai|Lightning Field|Jayce}} can be cast during the dash.''
params.effect radius: {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|300|Damage radius in front of Jayce}}
params.notes: * ''To The Skies!'' will always direct '''Jayce''' linearly to his target's location.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Jayce}} fires an electric bolt in the target direction that detonates upon hitting an enemy or max range, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies.
params.blurb2: If the bolt passes through ''{{ai|Acceleration Gate|Jayce}}'', it supercharges: instantly increasing its speed, travel distance and detonation.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jayce''' fires an electric bolt in the target direction that detonates upon hitting an enemy or reaching maximum range, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies and granting {{tip|sight}} of the area for {{fd|1.25}} seconds.
params.description2: If the bolt passes through ''{{ai|Acceleration Gate|Jayce}}'', it becomes supercharged: increasing its {{ccs|damage by 40%|physical}} as well as its speed, range and explosion radius.
params.range: {{dv|{{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{tt|1050|Standard missile range}}|{{tt|1600|Enhanced missile total range}}}}
params.width: {{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{tt|140|Both standard and enhanced missile width}}
params.effect radius: {{dv|{{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|170|Standard blast radius}}|{{tt|250|Enhanced blast radius}}|{{tip|sight|icononly = true}}{{tt|160|Standard blast sight radius}}|{{tip|sight|icononly = true}}{{tt|250|Enhanced blast sight radius}}}}
params.notes:
{{Effect at cast time end}}
* Upon touching {{ai|Acceleration Gate|Jayce}}, the enhanced missile gains its remaining range equal to [ 1600 units - travelled distance of the standard missile ].
** This means that the range of the enhanced ''Shock Blast'' is always the same, regardless of how early or late it interacted with ''Acceleration Gate''.
** Supercharging the ''Shock Blast'' as soon as possible, however, will improve its average speed significantly. 
*** For this, '''Jayce''' must stand inside or very close to the ''Acceleration Gate'', or place it very close to himself right after ''Shock Blast's'' cast time.
* ''Shock Blast's'' effect radius is centered around the location of the missile as it collides.
** ''Shock Blast'' will '''always''' damage the enemy it collided with, even if it is so large that it is outside the effect radius.
* The non-enhanced ''Shock Blast'' detonation has a slightly smaller sight radius than the radius in which it deals damage.{{bug|2}}

params.blurb2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jayce''' surrounds himself with an electric field for a few seconds, continually dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies.
params.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jayce''' surrounds himself with an electric field for 4 seconds that deals {{as|magic damage}} every second to nearby enemies.
params.leveling2: {{st|Magic Damage Per Tick|{{ap|35 to 110 6}} {{as|(+ 25% AP)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|35*4 to 110*4 6}} {{as|(+ 100% AP)}}}}

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Jayce}} gains a massive burst of {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} on his next few basic attacks, each one dealing {{as|'''modified''' physical damage}}.
params.description:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Jayce''' empowers his next 3 [[basic attack]]s within 4 seconds to deal {{as|'''modified''' physical damage}} and gain {{sti|attack speed|{{as|360% '''bonus''' attack speed}}}}.

''Hyper Charge's'' '''total''' damage is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers.
params.leveling: {{st|Physical Damage|{{as|{{ap|70 to 110 6}}% AD}}|Total Physical Damage|{{as|{{ap|70*3 to 110*3 6}}% AD}}}}
params.description2: ''Hyper Charge {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Jayce's''' basic attack timer.''
params.notes:
* The last basic attack is checked [[on-hit]] rather than [[on-attack]].
** If {{ii|Runaan's Hurricane}} or {{ii|Guinsoo's Rageblade}} hit the target before the basic attack does, the basic attack damage will not be modified.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Jayce}} swings his hammer at the target enemy, briefly {{tip|root|rooting}} them and dealing {{as|magic damage}} based on the {{as|'''target's''' maximum health}}, then {{tip|airborne|knocks}} them back.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jayce''' {{tip|root|roots}} the target enemy over the cast time, then swings his hammer at them to deal {{as|magic damage}}, capped against {{tip|monsters}}, and {{tip|airborne|knock them back}} 600 units.
params.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{as|{{ap|8 to 22 6}}% of target's '''maximum''' health}} {{as|(+ 100% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
{{st|Capped Monster Damage|{{ap|200 to 700 6}}}}
params.description3: '''''Jayce''' is unable to cast {{ai|To the Skies!|Jayce}} or {{ai|Shock Blast|Jayce}} for {{fd|0.4}} seconds after Thundering Blow's cast time.''

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Jayce}} deploys an energy gate centered at the target location for a few seconds. All allied champions that touch the gate will gain a burst of {{sti|{{as|movement speed}}}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jayce''' deploys an energy gate centered at the target location, lasting for 4 seconds and granting {{tip|sight}} of its surroundings. '''Jayce''' and allied champions can move through the gate to gain {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} that decays over 3 seconds, with the duration refreshing continuously while within the gate.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Jayce}} transforms into {{cci|Transform Mercury Cannon.png||{{sbc|Cannon Stance}}}}, becoming {{tip|ranged}} with greater {{sti|attack range}} and gaining new {{tip|abilities}}.
params.blurb2: His next {{tip|basic attack}} will reduce the target's {{sti|lethality|{{as|armor}}}} and {{sti|mpen|{{as|magic resist}}}} for a few seconds.
params.blurb4: '''Jayce''' begins the game with ''Transform'' but cannot increase its rank. Instead, his basic abilities each have 6 ranks.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jayce''' transforms into {{cci|Transform Mercury Cannon.png||{{sbc|Cannon Stance}}}}, receiving access to its {{tip|abilities}}, becoming {{tip|ranged}} with {{sti|500 attack range}}, and empowering his next {{tip|basic attack}} to reduce the target's {{sti|armor penetration|{{as|armor}}}} and {{sti|magic penetration|{{as|magic resistance}}}} by {{pp|key=%|20 to 35 for 4|1 to 16}} for 5 seconds.
params.notes:
* Transformations do not count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.
* The resistance reduction does not apply to structures.
* Both ''Transform'' on-hit effects have no set duration and will only be consumed when ''Jayce'' either lands a basic attack or switches stances.
* The enhanced attack will not be consumed if it is parried ({{tip|dodge}}, {{tip|block}}, {{tip|blind}}, and {{ai|Riposte|Fiora}}).
* The empowered attack will not trigger against {{tip|structures}} nor {{tip|wards}}.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Jayce}} transforms into {{cci|Transform Mercury Hammer.png||{{sbc|Hammer Stance}}}}, becoming {{tip|melee}}, gaining {{Sti|{{As|'''bonus''' armor}}}} and {{Sti|{{As|'''bonus''' magic resist}}}} and gaining new abilities.
params.blurb2: His next basic attack will deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}.
params.blurb4: '''Jayce''' begins the game with ''Transform'' but cannot increase its rank. Instead, his basic abilities each have 6 ranks.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jayce''' transforms into {{cci|Transform Mercury Hammer.png||{{sbc|Hammer Stance}}}}, receiving access to its {{tip|abilities}}, becoming {{tip|melee}} with {{sti|125 attack range}}, gaining {{pp|5 to 26 for 4|1 to 16}} {{as|(+ {{fd|7.5}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{sti|armor|{{as|'''bonus''' armor}}}} and {{sti|mr|{{as|'''bonus''' magic resistance}}}}, and empowering his next basic attack to deal {{as|{{pp|25 to 130 for 4|1 to 16}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 30% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}.
params.description2: '''Jayce''' begins the game with ''Transform'' but cannot increase its rank. Instead, his basic {{tip|abilities}} each have 6 ranks.
params.notes:
*Transformations do not count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.
* The enhanced attack will not be consumed if it is parried ({{tip|dodge}}, {{tip|block}}, {{tip|blind}}, and {{ai|Riposte|Fiora}}).
* The ''Mercury Hammer's'' bonus damage can affect structures.
* Both ''Transform'' on-hit effects have no set duration and will only be consumed when '''Jayce''' either lands a basic attack or switches stances.
* The empowered attack will not trigger against {{tip|wards}}.
* {{as|Armor}} and {{as|magic resist}} gained in {{cci|Transform Mercury Hammer.png||{{sbc|Hammer Stance}}}} do not scale off of the bonus {{as|attack damage}} granted by {{tip|adaptive force}} and [[Role Quests#Quests|mid lane quest's]] {{as|bonus AD}} multiplier.{{bug}}
